media.caption: Jaguar XKR coupe — 2012 US 510-hp specification — Facelift X150 XKR at the 2012 Chongqing Auto Show; US-market equipment is not certified. Factory engine originality and optional equipment are not certified by the photograph.
media.creator: Navigator84

cars.generation: Original F-Type R V8 coupe launch
cars.specification_market: Jaguar US November 20, 2013 announcement explicitly lists 2015 model pricing and spring 2014 introduction. Original R coupe, rear drive, 550 hp; later AWD, SVR and convertible figures are excluded. Optional post-introduction carbon-ceramic brakes are not standard. The 2013 World Car Design award described by the release belongs to the convertible and is not claimed for this R coupe. Photo identifies a 2015 R coupe; exact market and engine originality are unverified.
cars.summary: The original F-Type R is a defining modern Jaguar sports coupe, bringing the C-X16 concept’s Ian Callum design into production with a bonded and riveted aluminium structure, supercharged V8, active rear differential and brake-based torque vectoring.
